$comment: The runtimes the sandbox frames use, pinned by version and SHA-256 (lowercase hex). The page fetches each file through web/src/security/net.ts (purpose download), refuses it unless its hash matches, and transfers it into the frame. Pyodide packages are pinned by the sha256 of each entry of pyodide-lock.json, itself pinned here. The versions equal the exact devDependencies of web/package.json, whose files the unit tests hash against this lock and the e2e tests serve offline. Changing a version or a hash is a reviewed change.
